label: Red #50 · reviewed identity
disclosure: Red #50 combines three SAM2 fragments using assistant review of jersey numbers and chronological crops. The two joins are manual review decisions, not automatic reconnection results. Only accepted observed positions are drawn; gaps and the rest of the five-minute recording stay empty.

associations.reason: Jersey 50 repeatedly readable at center and in the left zone; one-second crops and gap endpoints reviewed. Player leaves the left edge during a rapid pan.
Reappears at the left image edge after the pan. Jersey 50 readable at frames 2715 and 2850; same helmet, shorts and leg equipment. No positions filled during the gap.

Continuation at the same left image edge after a four-frame missing interval, then returns into view. Jersey 50 visible as the player runs toward the far side. Stop the reviewed association before the crowded overlap at the end of this fragment.

review_method: Viewed chronological crops every second plus fragment endpoints and both sides of within-track detection gaps. Also viewed seven-sample contact sheets for other red players and dense alternatives T61, T140, T173. No claim of exhaustive per-frame identity ground truth.

exclusions.reason: Earlier white-helmet player has insufficient readable number evidence for a confident join to 50.
Different simultaneous player; later fragment switches to goalie.
Crowded overlap; excluded from the reviewed player identity.

known_limits: Unreviewed intervals are unknown, not proven bench time or absence from the floor. Identity review does not establish ankle or floor-position accuracy.
